snippet.title: SimplePlanes Builds in SimplePlanes 2!!!
snippet.description:
We're bringing back the SimplePlanes Player Content series, but with a twist! This time, we're showcasing incredible community-built crafts inside SimplePlanes 2! Get a sneak peek of the new stuff in SP2 while checking out some of the most impressive creations from the community.

SimplePlanes 2 is in active development and this player content series will give you a front-row seat to watch it evolve over the coming months as we approach its release on Steam later this year, with a mobile release planned for 2026.

Wishlist it now on Steam and stay tuned for more updates:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840470/SimplePlanes_2/

This video was created by @Vincent. You can check out his YouTube channel here:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCun38IipApBUzgKWZBgiWmA

Player crafts in this video:
https://simpleplanes.com/a/7Z401U
https://simpleplanes.com/a/zwUm9D
https://simpleplanes.com/a/FX41Ur
https://simpleplanes.com/a/LK4K35
https://simpleplanes.com/a/iMgGz1

Song: Giant - Abbynoise
